item.description: An Annapolis Sailing Couple’s Strategy and Daunting Journey Sailing Through Orca Alley One hundred nautical miles southwest of Portugal, in the darkness of night, in the deep, open ocean, there was a long sigh of relief from the cockpit. item.title: Cold Weather Sailing
item.description: Cold weather sailing can be enjoyable and peaceful, with quiet waterways, steady breezes (without the chance of a summer Chesapeake pop-up thunderstorm), and crisp, beautiful views of the Bay and its shoreline. item.title: A Joyful Offshore Passage Cruising the Atlantic Aboard a Hylas 57
item.description: Offshore sailing doesn’t always have to be about survival. Sometimes it’s about preparation, planning, and the joy of the miles between two distant shores.
